# netskope_urllist (Resource)

Manages a URL list for Netskope policies. URL lists define sets of URLs (exact match or regex) that can be referenced in security policies.

Changes are automatically deployed after each create, update, or delete operation.

## Example Usage

### Exact Match URL List

```terraform
resource "netskope_urllist" "blocked_sites" {
  name = "blocked-sites"
  data = {
    urls = [
      "www.example.com",
      "www.malicious-site.com",
    ]
    type = "exact"
  }
}
```

### Regex URL List

```terraform
resource "netskope_urllist" "regex_patterns" {
  name = "social-media-patterns"
  data = {
    urls = [
      ".*\\.facebook\\.com",
      ".*\\.twitter\\.com",
      ".*\\.instagram\\.com",
    ]
    type = "regex"
  }
}
```

## Import

Import by URL list ID:

```shell
terraform import netskope_urllist.example 42
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) URL list name
- `data` (Object) URL list data containing URLs and match type (see [Nested Schema](#nestedatt--data))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) URL list ID (assigned by API)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Required:

- `urls` (List of String) List of URLs or regex patterns
- `type` (String) URL matching type. Must be one of: `exact`, `regex`
